power.sky_storm.name: Storm and Sky
power.sky_storm.desc: The lord of sky, thunder and order: guarantor of guests and oaths.
power.sea.name: Sea and Waters
power.sea.desc: Salt and sweet water, seafarers, storms and earthquakes.
power.underworld.name: Underworld and Death
power.underworld.desc: The one realm of the dead with many gates; rest of the dead, wealth below.
power.harvest.name: Harvest and Earth
power.harvest.desc: Field, grain, fertility and the mysteries of sowing and reaping.
power.hearth.name: Hearth
power.hearth.desc: The fire of the home, family, the guest at the fire and the suppliant at the hearth.
power.forge.name: Forge and Fire
power.forge.desc: Craft, metal, weapons and the workshop fire.
power.knowledge.name: Knowledge and Runes
power.knowledge.desc: Writing, runes, wisdom, counsel and a cunning mind.
power.sun.name: Sun and Light
power.sun.desc: Light, prophecy, song and healing by light.
power.moon_hunt.name: Moon and Hunt
power.moon_hunt.desc: Night, moon, beasts, the hunt and childbirth.
power.road.name: Road, Trade, Trickery
power.road.desc: Roads, travellers, trade, messengers, theft and tricks.
power.wine.name: Wine and Ecstasy
power.wine.desc: Wine, mead, theatre, madness and the mysteries of ecstasy.
power.war.name: War
power.love.name: Love and Beauty
power.love.desc: Desire, love matches, beauty and spring.
power.fate.name: Fate
power.fate.desc: The spinners of fate: the span, the lot, the bond. They keep the world laws.
power.wild.name: The Wild
power.wild.desc: Woods, pastures, beasts, spirits of the place, nymphs and leshies.
power.healing.name: Healing and Plague
power.healing.desc: Healing, herbs, temple sleep, and plague as its shadow.
power.vengeance.name: Retribution
power.vengeance.desc: The avengers of a broken law: they hunt mortals and gods alike.

law.hospitality.name: Hospitality
law.hospitality.desc: A guest under a roof is inviolable: the host feeds and shields, the guest does the host no harm.
law.oath.name: Bond and Oath
law.oath.desc: A word sealed by the name of a Power binds; the Power sworn by punishes the oathbreaker.
law.exchange.name: Exchange with the Gods
law.exchange.desc: An offering made by the rule obliges the god to answer; a god may not take gifts and keep silent.
law.rest_dead.name: Rest of the Dead
law.rest_dead.desc: The dead are buried by the rite; defiled graves and raised shades bring a curse.
law.suppliant.name: The Suppliant
law.suppliant.desc: A suppliant who holds an altar or a hearth is inviolable until refused.
law.kin_blood.name: Kin Blood
law.kin_blood.desc: The blood of kin and betrayal of the family: the avengers hunt for it.
law.inviolable_will.name: Inviolable Will and Body
law.inviolable_will.desc: No one may be forced into intimacy or maimed: a grave crime in every cult.
law.mystery.name: Secret of the Mysteries
law.mystery.desc: Initiates do not reveal the secrets of the mysteries.

faith.hearth_faith.name: Hearth Faith
faith.hearth_faith.desc: The faith of the home and the commune: Hestia, Zeus, Demeter, Athena among the Hellenes; the Domovoi, Perun, Mokosh, Dazhbog and Veles in the woods; Ot-Ana and Umay on the steppe. The hearth fire, bread at the threshold, the guest at the fire.
faith.stone_ancestors.name: Stone of the Ancestors
faith.stone_ancestors.desc: The cult of ancestors and heroes: barrows, runes, oaths on stone. In the North Volund, Odin and Hel, on the steppe the Aruakh, Tengri and Umay.
faith.green_covenant.name: Green Covenant
faith.green_covenant.desc: The faith of field and wild land: Demeter, Persephone and Pan among the Hellenes, Danu, Cernunnos, the Dagda and Lugh in the Celtic groves. The first sheaf, the sacred grove.
faith.sky_blood.name: Sky and Blood
faith.sky_blood.desc: The faith of storm and battle: Thor, Odin, Tyr and Freyja in the North, Tengri and Kizagan on the steppe, Perun in the woods. An oath on the weapon, a fair fight, a barrow under the sky.
faith.many_spirits.name: Thousand Spirits
faith.many_spirits.desc: Spirits of the place: nymphs and Pan, the Leshy, the Bereginya and the Vodyanoy, Yer-Sub on the steppe. They are appeased with gifts and their groves and waters respected.
faith.moon_mother.name: Moon Mother
faith.moon_mother.desc: The faith of night, moon and hunt: Divia among the wood elves, Skadi and Hel among the fell trolls, Artemis and Selene in the south. The moon guards against the stone sleep.
faith.hoard_flame.name: Hoard Flame
faith.hoard_flame.desc: The faith of forge and flame: Hephaestus among the cyclopes, Volund among the jotuns, Svarog, Ptah; dragons see in it the First Flame. The best blade as a gift.
faith.pale_mourners.name: Pale Mourners
faith.pale_mourners.desc: The secret cult of those who would not let the dead go. They call the lords below (Hades and Persephone, Anubis, Hel, Veles, Erlik) to give back their own, breaking the law of the Rest of the Dead.
faith.sea_lord.name: Lord of the Waters
faith.sea_lord.desc: The faith of seafarers and islanders: Poseidon, Aegir and Ran, the Vodyanoy. Gold and a cup given to the wave, a horse at the shore, an oath on salt.
faith.sea_lord.day.calm_sea.name: Calm Sea
faith.sea_lord.day.storm_feast.name: Storm Feast
faith.sun_oracle.name: Sun Oracle
faith.sun_oracle.desc: The temple faith of the Nile and the light: Ra, Thoth, Isis and Osiris, Maat; on the Middle Sea Apollo and his oracle. Dawn hymns, embalming, the weighing of the heart.
faith.sun_oracle.day.dawn_of_year.name: Dawn of the Year
faith.sun_oracle.day.flood.name: the Flood
faith.road_trickster.name: Roads and Trade
faith.road_trickster.desc: The faith of traders, travellers and tricksters: Hermes, Loki, Puck. Stones at crossroads, gifts for the wayfarer, market oaths, jesters' rites.
faith.road_trickster.day.crossroads.name: Night of the Crossroads
faith.road_trickster.day.market_day.name: Great Market
faith.wine_mysteries.name: Bacchic Mysteries
faith.wine_mysteries.desc: The mysteries of wine and release: Dionysus, Kvasir, Osiris. Processions, masks, theatre and night feasts of the initiates; adults only and only by free will.
faith.wine_mysteries.day.vintage.name: Vintage
faith.wine_mysteries.day.dionysia.name: Great Dionysia
faith.knowledge_runes.name: Runes and Lore
faith.knowledge_runes.desc: The faith of the learned and the rune-wise: Odin, the Norns, Athena, Thoth, Ogma. An ordeal of initiation, runes and letters, contests of wit.
faith.fate_weavers.name: Weavers of Fate
faith.fate_weavers.desc: The faith of those who honour the lot and the bond: the Moirai, the Norns, Maat, the Sudenitsy. Spinning, divination, oaths before witnesses.
faith.love_feasts.name: Feasts of Love
faith.love_feasts.desc: The faith of love and spring: Aphrodite, Hathor, Freyja, Lada, Umay. Weddings, spring feasts, temple banquets; intimacy only by the free will of adults.
faith.love_feasts.day.spring_feast.name: Spring Feast
faith.love_feasts.day.rose_night.name: Night of Roses
faith.healer_vows.name: Healer Vows
faith.healer_vows.desc: The faith of healers: Asclepius and Apollo, Isis and Sekhmet, Eir, the Dagda. Temple sleep, herbs, vows.
faith.healer_vows.day.temple_sleep.name: Temple Sleep
